headline: EPS collapses year-over-year and sequentially
summary_short: Tenox reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥2.47, down 94.1% y/y from ¥41.69.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥2.47 fell 94.1% year-over-year from ¥41.69, and dropped 96.8% sequentially from ¥76.55 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
